q: I only have payment receipts for electricity, not the bills. Can I work out emissions?
title: Electricity receipts without the bill
short: Not reliably. The amount includes fixed charges, demand charges, duty and taxes, so rupees do not convert cleanly to kWh. Download the bills from your discom's portal or ask the office for duplicates; the units consumed on the bill are what you multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
audience: Small businesses with incomplete electricity records

ul: The discom consumer portal or app, using the consumer number.
The local subdivision office, for duplicates.
Your bank statement only to confirm which months were paid.

sections.h: If a month is truly missing
p: Estimate it from the months either side or from meter readings, label it as an estimate and replace it when the bill turns up.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
